title: Mirrored Meteor and Milky Way
explanation:
# Rewrite

A brilliant Perseid meteor streaked across the night sky above a cutting-edge telescope in Spain's Canary Islands, its colorful trail blazing across a backdrop of the Milky Way's glowing stars and dark dust clouds. The massive 23-meter mirror of the LST-1 telescope, which normally hunts for invisible gamma-rays from exploding stars and distant galaxies by catching their ultra-brief flashes of light, happened to catch the meteor's atmospheric glow in its reflection that night.
